rows.active_control: Nonempty JWT enables protected-route bearer/RBAC checks; healthz/readyz/metrics remain exempt. Empty JWT disables user enforcement.
rows.coverage_boundary: Default bind/exposure and signing-secret configuration belong to operator; green probes do not authenticate writes.

rows.active_control: requiredRole permits selected GETs; metadata omits plaintext; audit listing requires admin.
rows.coverage_boundary: Workload stdout can contain secrets; readable logs are not universally sanitized.

rows.active_control: Ordinary mutations enter built-in admission/reference/quota paths; jobs/newer routes can use admin fallback.
rows.coverage_boundary: Do not infer all workload types share ServiceSpec admission or resource propagation.

rows.surface: Explicit selected namespace and object IDs
rows.active_control: RoleForNamespace and Matches establish logical context; namespace management additionally requires a valid global role.
rows.coverage_boundary: Namespace admin is an admin role scoped in JWT, not a new independent global role or network boundary.

rows.active_control: Opaque32-byte-issued bearer token validated against node-bound hashed record, expiry/revocation and task ownership.
rows.coverage_boundary: Authorized execution includes decrypted secrets; daemon authority makes host compromise consequential.

rows.active_control: Bootstrap enrollment is separate from15-minute node bearer credentials; new issuance clears revoked record.
rows.coverage_boundary: Bootstrap custody remains important after revocation; no certificate/mTLS identity is active.

rows.active_control: Server replaces credential record before response; lost rotation response can strand old bearer.
rows.coverage_boundary: Not a seamless recovery guarantee; retain response-loss scenario and separately design dual-token/ack protocol.

rows.active_control: Startup bootstrap token protects log route; node-enrolled credential is a different protocol.
rows.coverage_boundary: Actual bind is configurable; endpoint is not automatically confined to loopback by its advertised URL.

rows.active_control: Disabled by default, configured loopback default; direct handler has no authentication.
rows.coverage_boundary: Changing debug address to public changes exposure; public API JWT does not wrap this separate listener.

rows.active_control: Only started when configured; namespace name selects query records.
rows.coverage_boundary: No user JWT/RBAC on DNS; address spelling does not provide confidentiality or tenant network isolation.

rows.active_control: Validated path/scheme, assigned published port, agent-generated loopback target, timeout, same-origin redirects and64KiB read cap.
rows.coverage_boundary: Generic checker accepts arbitrary initial Target from another caller; no universal allowlist inferred.

rows.active_control: URL validation, timeout, retry and optional HMAC signature; selected redaction.
rows.coverage_boundary: No inherited healthcheck destination restrictions; default redirect behavior separate; body drain is time-bounded rather than size-capped.

rows.active_control: Reject obvious URL credentials; argument slice and bounded owned checkout; configured path validation.
rows.coverage_boundary: No healthcheck egress allowlist; Git transport/configuration and path/symlink behavior need separate controls.

rows.actor: Secret metadata reader / authorized task recipient
rows.active_control: AES-GCM nonce-prefixed ciphertext and KeyID authenticated data; decrypt only for relevant task execution.
rows.coverage_boundary: Plaintext necessarily exists in server/agent/daemon/application; key separate from database dump; no KMS rotation.

rows.active_control: Ordinary service SecurityContext propagated to user/rootfs/capabilities/host options; static policy denies risky defaults.
rows.coverage_boundary: Writable mounts remain separate; Docker socket/host kernel common trust domain; resource limits dropped on ordinary path.

rows.active_control: Supplied digest syntax/pinning implemented; signatures/SBOM/scanning are design-only plus supplied-verdict teaching contract.
rows.coverage_boundary: No remote registry resolution, authenticity or vulnerability guarantee; fake-verdict pass is not scanner execution.

rows.active_control: Namespace-local metadata resolves VolumeName into Docker bind name.
rows.coverage_boundary: No namespace/UUID suffix added to physical name; metadataRWO cannot fence stale writer or replicate bytes.

rows.active_control: Static high-signal scan plus manual synthetic fixture/channel inspection.
rows.coverage_boundary: No key/token/private-author-email hits in scanned authored text; pattern scan alone is not a secrecy proof.
